name: 29354-smallbatchdecode-30ba3bint8-1gpu
model: nytopop/Qwen3-30B-A3B.w8a8. Ungated, compressed-tensors int8 (`int-quantized`), 7 safetensors shards, ~31 GB, complete in the local HF cache. Same architecture and the same 128-expert / top-8 routing as the bf16 Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B it was quantized from; the int8 is in the checkpoint, so the engine quantizes nothing at load.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism: every layer's 128 experts live on the one card.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 48 layers (all MoE), 128 experts per layer with 8 per token, hidden 2048, expert intermediate 768, 32 query / 4 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, vocab 151936, 40960 native context. Every Linear is symmetric per-output-channel int8 with dynamic per-token int8 activations; the 48 router gates and lm_head are excluded and stay bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 20% by completion, cooldown 10%, bounded at 100 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, static seed 29354.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, streaming, no chat template: 1024 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens per request, min == max on both. `ignore_eos` is forced, so every request emits exactly 512 tokens; prompts go on the wire as raw text (`request_format: plain`).
purpose: A compact mixture-of-experts chat assistant streaming 512-token replies to four concurrent users from a single GPU.
launch:
model: nytopop/Qwen3-30B-A3B.w8a8

# The checkpoint is already int8 and says so itself: compressed-tensors `int-quantized`, symmetric
# per-output-channel int8 weights with dynamic per-token int8 activations, on every Linear except
# the 48 router gates and lm_head. The engine reads that off the checkpoint's own
# `quantization_config`, so no `quantization:` override is set here and nothing is quantized at
# load time.

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Written down rather than left to resolve: the default pair depends on how the engine is
# constructed, and neither binds at four concurrent requests.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
